name: repo_query
description: Read-only git repo state queries for the rsi-agent workspace (no writes, no network). Prefer `state` as the single first check before commit/push/release: it returns status (branch + porcelain dirty list, UTF-8 paths), diff_stat (working tree+staged vs HEAD), log (last 10 oneline) and ahead (unpushed commits) in ONE call. Other subs: status, diff_stat, log, ahead, branch (current + upstream), remote, tags (version-desc). Paths are never octal-escaped (core.quotepath=false).

query.description: state (default; all-in-one) | status | diff_stat | log | ahead | branch | remote | tags
